method: Whole scanner3187 lines read in six contiguous ranges; README332 lines whole text, referenced images not yet inspected. Portable original C++ container/path-update extraction compiled with clang++ C++17, synthetic index only.
control_adapters: Win32 types/IO absent: original ResolvePathForFrn through ApplyIndexedFilesOnlyLocked container functions extracted unchanged.
Synthetic global state and distinct USN reason bits supplied; ASCII-only case-insensitive path equality/boundary helpers replace CompareStringOrdinal. No Unicode/Windows API parity claim.
findings: Confirmed original ApplyUsnBatchLocked rename bug: old-directory resolution populates path_cache; node changes to New but new-path resolution hits old cache. Existing child remains C:/Old/existing.txt and same-batch created child C:/Old/created.txt; later batch resolves new directory. No live journal run needed for isolated transition, but actual Windows integration untested.

Original same-FRN upsert replaces earlier path; file identity map supports one path per FRN. Hardlink discovery completeness and cross-volume identity require separate qualification, not demonstrated with real NTFS here.

Duplicate algorithm uses size, quick first/tail64KiB hash, full hash, then byte verification against cluster representative; static files are not declared equal from hash alone. Prefix/tail may overlap for small files; no measured performance claim.

All file reads permit concurrent writes/deletion and reopen by path; no before/after identity-size-timestamp verification encloses quick/full/byte stages. Returned metadata may describe earlier version. No real mutation race demonstrated.
Read/open/metadata errors are skipped; boolean byte comparator conflates unequal, cancellation and IO error. Duplicate return lacks per-file coverage/error inventory.

Public min_size0 maps to1MiB, positive min_size excludes empty files; internal empty-file fast path is unreachable via this exported wrapper. Is this desired default or missing public empty-file support needs API contract review.

max_groups stops during unordered-map traversal before reclaimable-size sorting, so sorted returned set is not proven global top groups. Rendered members capped2..400 while fileCount/totalBytes describe full cluster.

Fallback enumeration ignores all FindFirst errors and never distinguishes FindNext error from normal end; may publish partial index success. Multi-drive partial failures are accumulated then cleared if any drive succeeds.
Multi-drive mode publishes files-only state without a watcher; README blanket incremental-updates claim requires scope qualification.
Search retains shared index lock across synchronous file content reads. This may delay exclusive index updates; no timing measured.
StopLiveWatcher changes token but no join; watcher rechecks token before acquiring index lock, not after; replacement-index interleaving remains a static race hypothesis.
Public duplicate scan marks running false before serialization and final cancel flag reset; possible concurrent new scan/state reset interleaving remains static, not concurrency-tested.
USN v3 support is preprocessor guarded by defined(USN_RECORD_V3); exact Windows SDK build qualification absent. FileId128ToU64 retains only first8bytes where enabled.

Local exact.rs explicitly documents stable observations rather than atomic snapshot and contains changed-file/snapshot regressions. Upstream issues are not assumed local defects; no production code changes.
